identity.name: Octa Chronometre Souverain 40mm Brass
identity.one_liner: The F.P. Journe Octa — a 40mm platinum dress watch with the in-house 1304 manual movement, a deadbeat seconds sub-dial, and a brass or silver dial. The most-cited F.P. Journe in Asia.

provenance_events.description: François-Paul Journe releases the Octa Chronometre Souverain — a 40mm platinum dress watch with the in-house 1304 manual movement.

narrative.story: The Octa Chronometre Souverain is the watch that established F.P. Journe as a major independent. The 1304 movement is a manual-wind with a 56-hour reserve, a free-sprung balance, and a deadbeat seconds sub-dial.
narrative.collector_notes: The 1304 movement is one of the most-cited independent movements of the 2000s — hand-finished, free-sprung balance, deadbeat seconds, 56-hour reserve.
